tag.name: GA4 - search
tag.notes: Top of the funnel: a results page was shown (search.js). freetext_place says which ends were typed, not picked.

tag.name: GA4 - view_item_list
tag.notes: What was put in front of them: search results, the planner, a customer quote, or the ride board.

tag.name: GA4 - select_item
tag.notes: They picked one: a result, a quote option, a board van, or the planner dates step.

tag.name: GA4 - begin_checkout
tag.notes: Entered checkout: booking page, pay link, manage balance, board join, or planner hand-off.

tag.name: GA4 - checkout_step
tag.notes: Forward progress through the booking steps (when / where / pax or service / payment).

tag.name: GA4 - add_payment_info
tag.notes: Chose a payment plan (booking) or reached the pay step (pay link).

tag.name: GA4 - purchase
tag.notes: Revenue. Gated in code to real hosts and de-duplicated per booking reference.

tag.name: GA4 - view_item
tag.notes: A pay link was opened on something payable.

tag.name: GA4 - exception
tag.notes: The ride board hit an error it could not recover from.

tag.name: Google Ads - purchase
tag.notes: Replaces the WordPress-era conversion that fired on /my-account/ URLs, which the new site does not have.

tag.name: Conversion Linker
tag.notes: Keeps the Google Ads click id across pages so the purchase conversion can be attributed.
